title: Frukt Cyder Peach Apricot Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Frukt Cyder’s newest flavour combines the softest, most succulent plums with the sun-soaked sweetness of tangy apricots and juicy peaches, swirled into bubbly apple cider to create an irresistible taste of summer all-year round. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend strikes the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
